title: Resources Extended
description: Resources Extended aims to extend the use-cases for Resources with Armor, Swords and more
body:
![Resource Extended full logo (text)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fee0594eabed03bd276159cf8f2ea44ec860fa62_0.webp)

**Resources Extended** aims to extend the Content of Resources that could use some. Resources Extended (RE for short) works in both Survival and Creative mode.
  - **Resources Extended is currently in Alpha meaning that there may be bugs, this Mod isn't finished yet**

Current Content includes :

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- Lapis Lazuli (sits in between Diamond and Iron with an Enchantability Bonus)
  - Lapis Lazuli **full Armor set**
  - Lapis Lazuli **full Tool set** (Sword, Pickaxe, Axe...)
  - Lapis Lazuli **Staff**
  - A new Enchantment called **"Mana Damage"** that:
    - Adds a **Weakness** and **Instant Damage** Affect onto the target with a Chance of **1:50** with the Level 1 Enchantment and **1:20** for the Level 2 Enchantment
    - The Effects are also weaker on Level 1 than on Level 2
  - **Engraved Lapis Lazuli Armor**
    - Almost **as Strong as Diamond Armor**

</details>
